description_en: Configures the status of the container firewall feature
description_zh: 设置容器防火墙防护的防御状态
name: SetClusterInterceptionConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster. Separate multiple cluster IDs with commas (,).

You can call the [ListClusterInterceptionConfig](~~ListClusterInterceptionConfig~~) operation to query the IDs of clusters
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。多个集群ID使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
您可以调用[ListClusterInterceptionConfig](~~ListClusterInterceptionConfig~~)获取该参数
parameters.name: cluster_ids

parameters.help_en:
The type of the switch that you want to configure. Valid values:

0: the interception switch
1: the interception type switch
2: the interception history switch
parameters.help_zh:
需要设置的开关类型。取值：
0：拦截功能开关
1：拦截类型开关
2：拦截历史开关
parameters.name: switch_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to turn on the switch. Valid values:

1: yes
0: no
parameters.help_zh:
开关操作。取值：

1：开启
0：关闭
parameters.name: switch_on

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Result.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Result.description_zh:
请求处理结果。取值：
true：处理成功
false：处理失败
